Source article title: Gloria J. Romero
Source introduction:
Gloria J. Romero (Republican Party) is running for election for Lieutenant Governor of California. She is on the ballot in the general election on November 3, 2026. She advanced from the primary on June 2, 2026.
Romero (Democratic Party) was a member of the California State Senate, representing District 24. She assumed office in 2001. She left office in 2010.
Romero completed Ballotpedia's Candidate Connection survey in 2026. Click here to read the survey answers.
On September 4, 2024, Romero announced she is leaving the Democratic Party and will switch to a Republican.

A named voter guide/Sway voting group is a recommendation, not automatically a formal endorsement. Keep awards/designations distinct; do not turn generic mention, donations, candidate opponents, or lists of candidates this person endorsed into endorsements OF this candidate. The generic boilerplate combines endorsements and recommendations: use the specific entry and its category. Do not rely on URL filenames alone. Hold ambiguous cases.

criteria.endorsed: The source reports this named entity endorsing this candidate

criteria.unrelated: Mention, navigation, donor, opponent or reverse endorsement
